sloka: महासात्त्वो महातेज महाबल पराक्रमः ।लंघने प्लवने चैव भविष्यति मया समः ॥४-६६-१९॥
transliteration: mahāsāttvo mahāteja mahābala parākramaḥ ।laṁghane plavane caiva bhaviṣyati mayā samaḥ ॥4-66-19॥

translations.english: 'He will be very powerful, illustrious and will be of great valour and strength. He will be my equal in leaping and flying'.
